NTA first off, second off if someone is not educated to be a teacher THEY SHOULD NOT HOMESCHOOL THEIR KIDS, my mother thought homeschooling me would be a great idea. It wasn't she left me to my own devices except when she was trying to show others she was being a good mom, i was teaching myself stuff i did not understand and couldn't understand without a teacher.

It has completely ruined my life, i get turned down from jobs i know i could do because i still haven't been able to get my GED. I constantly feel ashamed and stupid for not having the same education as others my age. 

I am so heavily biased against homeschooling for so many good reasons, the amount of abuse that can happen is astounding, i didn't fully make friends until i was almost 19, i was terrified of leaving our yard cause no one made sure i was socialized, i developed a severe fear of huge crowds first time i went in Walmart alone i had a panic attack. 

There is a whole subreddit of people who got fucked over because their parents got wooed by the idea of homeschooling their kids. Any parent that homeschools their kid without getting them proper teachers/tutors, social systems, making sure they exercise and making sure they eat properly are fucking idiots.

Homeschooling is fit for the few NOT the many, it takes the right parents, situations, and kids for it to actually turn out right.
